title: 第21章 你们太弱了第22章 什么东西的骨头能硬成这样
slug: 玄幻穿成野狗生崽就能变强
lines: 横云山后山的崖壁上。
林野跳下鹰背，叼着幼崽走进巢穴。
菀月看见林野嘴里叼着的毛团，冲到跟前，鼻尖凑上去嗅了又嗅。
林野把幼崽放在她爪前。
林默翻了个身，菀月低头舔了舔幼崽的后脑勺，舔了半天，才抬起头看林野。
“以后，不许再让它离开我三步。”
林野没接话。
这崽子身上的东西太扎眼了，狼王血脉加上品雷灵根，搁在任何一个修士眼里都是行走的天材地宝。
藏着不是长久之计，唯一的办法，让自己强到没人敢伸手。
林野转身走出巢穴，站在崖壁边缘俯瞰大峰。
月光底下，横云山三峰之间的谷地里，黑狼族群的公狼散布在各个哨位上。
灰狐和獐子妖缩在角落里打盹，巡逻的黑狼跑过，它们连头都不抬一下。
松散，毫无战斗力可言。
这帮东西，守个山头都费劲，更别说挡住有组织的修士渗透。
靠林野一个人守两座山，迟早出漏洞，他得练兵。
天亮之后，林野从崖壁上跳下来，一声低吼送出去。
尖牙带着八只公狼从各个方向汇过来，整整齐齐蹲在大峰练功场的石台下方。
后面跟着新收编的赤鳞蜥蜴，独角犀牛妖，趴了一片。
林野扫了一圈。
“昨晚有人摸进后山，偷了我的崽子。”
“巫风三百年道行，没察觉，五个筑基都不到的穷修士，用一把安息香粉就骗过了所有人的鼻子。”
“你们太弱了。”
没有一只妖兽吭声。
林野从乾坤袋里扒出一堆东西倒在石台上。
丹瓶，功法拓本，从各处搜刮的，堆了小半个石台。
“青河宗的基础功法，适合百年以下的妖兽参悟，这几瓶是淬体丹，低阶货，但对你们够用了”
“从今天起，公狼分四组轮训。白天练体术和配合，晚上用灵泉水泡着恢复。”
“两个月后，我要看到你们能挡住筑基中期的修士。”
尖牙的脊背弓起，脑袋磕在石面上。
“属下领命！”
在横云山被青河宗追杀的三年里，黑狼族群从来没有过功法，修炼全靠命去熬。
现在有人把这些东西堆在它面前，说拿去练。
是大王收了它们。
给灵泉喝，给地盘住，给肉吃，现在连功法丹药都发到爪子底下了。
尖牙的嗓子闷在泥里。
“大王，属下这条命，是您的。”
content_en:
On the cliff behind Hengyun Mountain.
Lin Ye jumped off the eagle's back and walked into the nest with the cub in his mouth.
Wan Yue saw the hair ball in Lin Ye's mouth, rushed to it, put her nose up and sniffed again and again.
Lin Ye put the cub in front of her paws.
Lin Mo turned over, and Wanyue lowered her head and licked the back of the cub's head. After licking for a long time, she raised her head to look at Lin Ye.
"Don't let it take another three steps away from me from now on."
Lin Ye didn't answer.
The things on this kid are too eye-catching. The bloodline of the Wolf King and the Pinlei Spiritual Root make him a walking treasure in the eyes of any monk.
Hiding is not a long-term solution, the only way is to make yourself so strong that no one dares to reach out.
Lin Ye turned around and walked out of the nest, standing on the edge of the cliff overlooking the peak.
Under the moonlight, in the valley between the three peaks of Hengyun Mountain, the male wolves of the black wolf group were scattered at various sentry posts.
The gray fox and deer demon huddled in the corner and took a nap. The patrolling black wolf ran by without even raising their heads.
It's loose and has no combat effectiveness at all.
These guys have a hard time guarding the top of the mountain, let alone blocking the infiltration of organized monks.
If he relies on the forest to defend two mountains by himself, sooner or later there will be a loophole, and he will have to train his troops.
After dawn, Lin Ye jumped down from the cliff and sent him out with a low roar.
Jian Ya and eight male wolves came from all directions and squatted neatly under the stone platform of Dafeng Training Ground.
Followed by the newly recruited red-scaled lizard, the one-horned rhinoceros demon, lying down.
Lin Ye swept around.
"Someone broke into the back mountain last night and stole my baby."
"Wufeng has been practicing Taoism for three hundred years, but he didn't notice that five poor monks who couldn't even build a foundation used a handful of benzoin powder to fool everyone."
"You are too weak."
Not a single monster said a word.
Lin Ye took out a bunch of things from the Qiankun bag and poured them on the stone platform.
Alchemy bottles and rubbings of the techniques were collected from everywhere, and were piled on half of the stone platform.
"The basic skills of Qinghe Sect are suitable for monsters who are under a hundred years old to understand. These bottles are body tempering pills, low-level goods, but they are enough for you."
"Starting from today, the male wolves will be divided into four groups for rotation training. During the day, they will practice physical skills and coordination, and at night, they will soak in spiritual spring water to recover."
"In two months, I want to see that you can block the monks in the middle stage of foundation building."
Sharptooth's back arched and his head hit the stone surface.
"Subordinates take orders!"
During the three years when they were hunted down by the Qinghe Sect in Hengyun Mountain, the Black Wolf Clan had never had any skills, and their cultivation relied on their lives.
Now some people pile these things in front of it and say that it can be practiced with.
It was the king who collected them.
They provide spiritual springs to drink from, territory to live in, and meat to eat. Now even the martial arts pills are distributed under their paws.
Sharptooth's throat was muffled in the mud.
"Your Majesty, this life belongs to you."
